name: AO SMITH Intelli-UV+Hot
summary: The A.O. Smith Intelli-UV+ Hot is a premium 6-stage UV water purifier designed for municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm) . Featuring India's First Dual Pass UV Chamber , SAPC , and Lead Shield Technology , it delivers safe, healthy, and lead-free drinking water.
intro: Experience safe and convenient drinking water with the A.O. Smith Intelli-UV+ Hot, featuring a 6-stage UV purification system with India's First Dual Pass UV Chamber, SAPC, and Lead Shield Technology for enhanced protection. Designed for municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm), it dispenses water in Hot (80°C), Warm (45°C), and Ambient modes through an intuitive touch display. Its elegant wall-mounted design, LED display, Night Assist feature, and 3.3 L food-grade storage tank make it a perfect addition to modern kitchens.
